$comment: Why every entry in package.json `overrides` exists, and when it must be re-justified.
This is the second half of the security ledger. `.osv-scanner.toml` records which
advisories we have consciously chosen NOT to fix yet, and every entry there expires
via `ignoreUntil`. Nothing watched the other direction: an exact pin like
sharp@0.35.0 cannot drift forward, Dependabot will not move it, and
dependency-review.yml only inspects newly-ADDED dependencies at PR time. So an
aging pin stayed invisible until the weekly OSV cron turned red days later
(2026-09-14, GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c in sharp and GHSA-vwc7-r8mq-g2x9 in adm-zip).
Every key in `overrides` needs an entry here with a reason and a reviewBy date.
test/override-freshness.test.ts runs in the free suite and fails the PR once a
reviewBy has passed — which turns an unwatched weekly cron failure into a gate
a human is already looking at.
Re-justifying means: check the current advisory state and upstream releases for
the package, bump the pin if it has fallen behind, then push reviewBy forward.

adm-zip.reason: Transitive via onnxruntime-node <- @huggingface/transformers, which asks for ^0.5.16. Pinned forward past GHSA-vwc7-r8mq-g2x9 (CVE-2026-76845, symlink-follow on extract lets a crafted archive overwrite files outside the target directory). No gstack source imports adm-zip.

ip-address.reason: Pinned to a single version to keep the socks/proxy-agent chain on one resolution; a floating range pulled two copies into the tree.

sharp.reason: Transitive via @huggingface/transformers, which asks for ^0.34.5. Pinned forward past GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c (bundled libheif RCE). gstack's only consumer is browse/src/screenshot-size-guard.ts, which downscales PNG screenshots and never decodes AVIF/HEIF, so real exposure was low, but the fix is a one-line bump.
